title: Own the problem as a design engineer
principle: When quality matters, one person (or a tight pair) owns design and implementation of a surface—so details don’t die in handoff gaps.
procedure: Assign a single owner for the risky surface.
Owner can change design in code without a ticket ping-pong.
Budget time for polish that only appears in the medium.
Review together on the deployed URL, not only in comps.
Write down decisions that comps would have missed.
